quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his early experience with the Philadelphia 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I'm the new guy here, so I'm still getting used to it, but I'm just finding ways to win.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the 76ers' current development stage
quotes.excerpt: We're in a very early stage of our development. We got some habits that we got to clear up.
quotes.quote: We're in a very early stage of our development. We got some habits that we got to clear up. We are predominantly surviving off of talent, but as we develop in that structure and that chemistry, we'll get better. We just got to keep taking steps forward, but we're not where we want to be right now, and I'm going to keep challenging us to get better.
